scope: Local mock-property verification; not production or physical-phone acceptance

service.method: Keyboard E take order, WASD around counter, E brew, wait 2.2 seconds, E serve. WebSocket snapshots observed only; no state injection.

sharedLayoutRoute.method: Two actual WebSocket clients; owner moves pickup then counter, guest receives accepted layout. Replay same seeded customer from identical position through stepSimulation for both layouts; sum movement segments.
sharedLayoutRoute.interpretation: Moving the counter required the already queued guest to walk approximately 4.01 additional world units. Demonstrates causal rerouting, not improved efficiency or measured business gains.
